format: html
execute:
  echo: true

---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

theme_file <- "../R/theme_dataforge.R"
if (file.exists(theme_file)) {
  source(theme_file)
} else {
  theme_dataforge <- function() theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
}

urls <- read_csv("../data/raw/kenya_urls.csv") |>
  mutate(url_length = nchar(url))
```

## Basic checks

```{r checks}
nrow(urls)
sum(duplicated(urls$url))
count(urls, sector, sort = TRUE)
count(urls, page_type, sort = TRUE)
```

## Links per sector

```{r sector}
by_sector <- count(urls, sector, sort = TRUE)
top_sector <- slice(by_sector, 1)

ggplot(by_sector, aes(x = reorder(sector, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7fb8") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(top_sector$sector, " has the most links (",
                   top_sector$n, " of ", nrow(urls), ")"),
    x = "Sector", y = "Number of URLs"
  ) +
  theme_dataforge()
```

## Links per page type

```{r pagetype}
by_type <- count(urls, page_type, sort = TRUE)
top_type <- slice(by_type, 1)

ggplot(by_type, aes(x = reorder(page_type, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7fb8") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(top_type$page_type, " pages make up ",
                   round(100 * top_type$n / nrow(urls)), "% of the list"),
    x = "Page type", y = "Number of URLs"
  ) +
  theme_dataforge()
```

## URL length

```{r length}
ggplot(urls, aes(x = url_length)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "#2c7fb8", colour = "white") +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Typical Kenyan URL is about ", round(median(urls$url_length)),
                   " characters long"),
    x = "URL length (characters)", y = "Number of URLs"
  ) +
  theme_dataforge()
```

## Sector and page type together

```{r sector-pagetype}
table(urls$sector, urls$page_type)
```

```{r findings-data}
#| echo: false
pct <- function(x) round(100 * mean(x))
host <- tolower(sub("^[a-z]+://([^/?#:]+).*$", "\\1", urls$url))
n_telco <- sum(urls$sector == "telco_mpesa")
share_type <- function(t) pct(urls$page_type == t)
len_by_type <- tapply(urls$url_length, urls$page_type, median)
```

## Findings

- The list has `r nrow(urls)` URLs from `r n_distinct(urls$organisation)` organisations across `r n_distinct(urls$sector)` sectors, with `r sum(duplicated(urls$url))` duplicates.
- The median URL is `r round(median(urls$url_length))` characters and the longest is `r max(urls$url_length)`.
- Deep pages have a median length of `r round(len_by_type[["deep"]])` characters, against `r round(len_by_type[["homepage"]])` for homepages and `r round(len_by_type[["login_service"]])` for login and service pages. A model that learns "long URL means phishing" will therefore treat Kenyan deep pages as more suspicious than homepages.
- The page-type mix is `r share_type("homepage")`% homepages, `r share_type("login_service")`% login or service pages and `r share_type("deep")`% deeper pages, against a plan of about a third each. Login and service pages are the under-represented group.
- Government and county sites make up `r pct(urls$sector %in% c("government", "county"))`% of the list, while telecom and M-Pesa has only `r n_telco` URLs (`r pct(urls$sector == "telco_mpesa")`%). The false-alarm test will mostly describe public-sector sites.
- `r pct(grepl("\\.ke$", host))`% of URLs sit on a `.ke` domain (`r pct(grepl("\\.go\\.ke$", host))`% on `.go.ke`, `r pct(grepl("\\.co\\.ke$", host))`% on `.co.ke`), and `r pct(!grepl("\\.ke$", host))`% are on other domains such as `.com`, so a Kenyan site is not always a `.ke` site.
- `r pct(grepl("?", urls$url, fixed = TRUE))`% of URLs carry a query string, and all `r nrow(urls)` use https, so HTTPS gives the model no signal on this list.
